{"name": "write_file", "arguments": {"path": ".github/workflows/deploy.yml", "content": "name: CI/CD Pipeline - SSL Termination & Rate Limiting

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, staging]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

env:
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}
  DEPLOY_HOST: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_HOST }}
  DEPLOY_USER: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_USER }}
  SSL_CERT_PATH: /etc/ssl/certs/app.crt
  SSL_KEY_PATH: /etc/ssl/private/app.key

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: write

jobs:
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Job 1: Lint & Static Analysis
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  lint:
    name: Lint & Static Analysis
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up runtime
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          cache: "npm"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run linter
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Run type check
        run: npm run typecheck

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Job 2: Unit & Integration Tests
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  test:
    name: Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [18, 20]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: "npm"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: npm run test:unit -- --coverage

      - name: Run integration tests
        run: npm run test:integration

      - name: Upload coverage report
        if: matrix.node-version == 20
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-report
          path: coverage/

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Job 3: Security Scan (SSL configs & deps)
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  security:
    name: Security Scan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run npm audit
        run: npm audit --audit-level=high
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Run Trivy vulnerability scanner
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
        with:
          scan-type: "fs"
          scan-ref: "."
          severity: "HIGH,CRITICAL"
          exit-code: "1"

      - name: Validate SSL/TLS configuration
        run: |
          echo "Checking Nginx SSL config for best practices..."
          # Ensure no TLS 1.0/1.1
          if grep -q "TLSv1 " deploy/nginx/ssl.conf || grep -q "TLSv1_1" deploy/nginx/ssl.conf; then
            echo "::error::Insecure TLS version found in SSL config"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Ensure strong ciphers only
          if grep -qi "RC4\|DES\|MD5\|NULL" deploy/nginx/ssl.conf; then
            echo "::error::Weak cipher found in SSL config"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "SSL configuration validation passed."

      - name: Validate rate-limiting config
        run: |
          echo "Checking rate-limiting configuration..."
          if ! grep -q "limit_req_zone" deploy/nginx/rate-limit.conf; then
            echo "::error::No rate-limiting zone defined"
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! grep -q "limit_req " deploy/nginx/rate-limit.conf; then
            echo "::error::Rate-limiting zone defined but not applied"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Rate-limiting configuration validation passed."

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Job 4: Build & Push Docker Image
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  build:
    name: Build & Push Image
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [test, security]
    if: github.event_name == 'push'
    outputs:
      image_tag: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
      image_digest: ${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Log in to Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract metadata
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}
          tags: |
            type=sha,prefix=
            type=ref,event=branch
            type=raw,value=latest,enable={{is_default_branch}}

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        id: build
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
          build-args: |
            NODE_ENV=production

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Job 5: Deploy to Staging
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  deploy-staging:
    name: Deploy to Staging
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/staging'
    environment:
      name: staging
      url: https://staging.example.com
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Deploy via SSH
        uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.STAGING_HOST }}
          username: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_USER }}
          key: ${{ secrets.SSH_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          script: |
            set -euo pipefail

            # Pull the latest image
            docker pull ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:staging

            # Stop existing containers
            docker compose -f /opt/app/docker-compose.staging.yml down || true

            # Deploy Nginx with SSL termination & rate limiting
            echo "Deploying Nginx reverse proxy (SSL termination + rate limiting)..."

            # Copy updated configs
            cp /opt/app/deploy/nginx/ssl.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/ssl.conf
            cp /opt/app/deploy/nginx/rate-limit.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/rate-limit.conf
            cp /opt/app/deploy/nginx/nginx.conf /etc/nginx/nginx.conf

            # Test Nginx config
            nginx -t

            # Start services
            docker compose -f /opt/app/docker-compose.staging.yml up -d

            # Reload Nginx with new SSL/rate-limit config
            nginx -s reload

            # Wait for health check
            sleep 10
            curl -sf https://staging.example.com/health || exit 1

      - name: Verify SSL certificate
        run: |
          echo "Verifying SSL certificate on staging..."
          echo | openssl s_client -connect ${{ secrets.STAGING_HOST }}:443 -servername staging.example.com 2>/dev/null | \
            openssl x509 -noout -dates -subject

      - name: Verify rate limiting
        run: |
          echo "Verifying rate limiting is active on staging..."
          RESPONSE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
            -H "Host: staging.example.com" \
            https://${{ secrets.STAGING_HOST }}/api/test)
          echo "Status: $RESPONSE"

          # Send burst of requests to trigger rate limit
          for i in $(seq 1 120); do
            STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
              -H "Host: staging.example.com" \
              https://${{ secrets.STAGING_HOST }}/api/test)
            if [ "$STATUS" = "429" ]; then
              echo "Rate limiting confirmed (429 received on request #$i)"
              break
            fi
          done

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Job 6: Deploy to Production
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  deploy-production:
    name: Deploy to Production
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    environment:
      name: production
      url: https://app.example.com
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Create deployment record
        id: deployment
        run: |
          echo "deployment_sha=${GITHUB_SHA::7}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "deployment_time=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Deploy via SSH
        uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.PROD_HOST }}
          username: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_USER }}
          key: ${{ secrets.SSH_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          script_stop: true
          command_timeout: 10m
          script: |
            set -euo pipefail

            echo "=== Production Deployment Started ==="

            # Pull the latest image
            docker pull ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:latest

            # Backup current Nginx config
            cp -r /etc/nginx/conf.d /etc/nginx/conf.d.backup.$(date +%s)

            # ────────────────────────────────────
            # SSL Certificate Renewal (Let's Encrypt)
            # ────────────────────────────────────
            echo "Checking SSL certificate renewal..."
            certbot renew --quiet --deploy-hook "nginx -s reload"

            # Copy updated configs
            cp /opt/app/deploy/nginx/ssl.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/ssl.conf
            cp /opt/app/deploy/nginx/rate-limit.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/rate-limit.conf
            cp /opt/app/deploy/nginx/nginx.conf /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
            cp /opt/app/deploy/nginx/security-headers.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/security-headers.conf

            # Test Nginx config before applying
            nginx -t

            # ────────────────────────────────────
            # Blue-Green Deployment
            # ────────────────────────────────────
            CURRENT=$(docker compose -f /opt/app/docker-compose.prod.yml ps --format json | jq -r '.[0].Labels["com.docker.compose.service"]' 2>/dev/null || echo "app-blue")

            if [ "$CURRENT" = "app-blue" ]; then
              TARGET="app-green"
              TARGET_PORT=8081
            else
              TARGET="app-blue"
              TARGET_PORT=8080
            fi

            echo "Switching from $CURRENT to $TARGET..."

            # Start new container
            docker compose -f /opt/app/docker-compose.prod.yml up -d $TARGET

            # Wait for health check
            for i in $(seq 1 30); do
              if curl -sf http://localhost:$TARGET_PORT/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                echo "$TARGET is healthy"
                break
              fi
              echo "Waiting for $TARGET health check... ($i/30)"
              sleep 2
            done

            # Update Nginx upstream to point to new target
            sed -i "s/server 127.0.0.1:80[0-9][0-9]/server 127.0.0.1:$TARGET_PORT/" /etc/nginx/conf.d/upstream.conf

            # Reload Nginx (zero-downtime switch with new SSL + rate-limit config)
            nginx -s reload

            # Stop old container
            docker compose -f /opt/app/docker-compose.prod.yml stop $CURRENT

            echo "=== Production Deployment Complete ==="

      - name: Verify SSL certificate (Production)
        run: |
          echo "Verifying SSL certificate on production..."
          CERT_INFO=$(echo | openssl s_client -connect ${{ secrets.PROD_HOST }}:443 -servername app.example.com 2>/dev/null | \
            openssl x509 -noout -dates -subject)
          echo "$CERT_INFO"

          # Ensure cert is not expired
          EXPIRY=$(echo "$CERT_INFO" | grep "notAfter" | cut -d= -f2)
          EXPIRY_EPOCH=$(date -d "$EXPIRY" +%s 2>/dev/null || date -j -f "%b %d %T %Y %Z" "$EXPIRY" +%s)
          NOW_EPOCH=$(date +%s)
          DAYS_LEFT=$(( (EXPIRY_EPOCH - NOW_EPOCH) / 86400 ))
          echo "Certificate expires in $DAYS_LEFT days"

          if [ "$DAYS_LEFT" -lt 7 ]; then
            echo "::warning::SSL certificate expires in less than 7 days!"
          fi

      - name: Verify rate limiting (Production)
        run: |
          echo "Verifying rate limiting is active on production..."
          # Check that rate limit headers are present
          HEADERS=$(curl -sI https://app.example.com/api/health)
          if echo "$HEADERS" | grep -qi "x-ratelimit"; then
            echo "Rate limiting headers confirmed"
          else
            echo "::warning::Rate limiting headers not found"
          fi

      - name: Run smoke tests
        run: |
          echo "Running smoke tests against production..."
          curl -sf https://app.example.com/health || exit 1
          curl -sf https://app.example.com/api/health || exit 1
          echo "All smoke tests passed!"

      - name: Notify deployment success
        if: success()
        run: |
          echo "Production deployment successful for commit ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.deployment_sha }}"

      - name: Rollback on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.PROD_HOST }}
          username: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_USER }}
          key: ${{ secrets.SSH_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          script: |
            echo "!!! Rolling back deployment !!!"
            # Restore backup Nginx config
            LATEST_BACKUP=$(ls -td /etc/nginx/conf.d.backup.* | head -1)
            cp -r "$LATEST_BACKUP"/* /etc/nginx/conf.d/
            nginx -t && nginx -s reload

            # Restart previous container
            docker compose -f /opt/app/docker-compose.prod.yml restart

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Job 7: Post-Deploy Monitoring
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  monitor:
    name: Post-Deploy Monitoring
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: deploy-production
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - name: Check application metrics
        run: |
          echo "Checking application metrics..."
          RESPONSE_TIME=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{time_total}" https://app.example.com/api/health)
          echo "Response time: ${RESPONSE_TIME}s"

          if (( $(echo "$RESPONSE_TIME > 2.0" | bc -l) )); then
            echo "::warning::High response time detected: ${RESPONSE_TIME}s"
          fi

      - name: Verify rate-limit metrics
        run: |
          echo "Checking rate-limit metrics endpoint..."
          curl -sf https://app.example.com/metrics | grep -E "nginx_http_requests_total|nginx_limit_req_status" || echo "Metrics check skipped"
"}}

{"name": "write_file", "arguments": {"path": "deploy/nginx/ssl.conf", "content": "# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# SSL/TLS Termination Configuration
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────

# --- Protocol versions ---
# Only TLS 1.2 and 1.3 are allowed — TLS 1.0/1.1 are insecure
ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;

# --- Cipher suites ---
# Ordered by preference: AEAD (TLS 1.3) first, then strong TLS 1.2 ciphers
# No RC4, DES, 3DES, MD5, NULL, or EXPORT ciphers
ssl_ciphers 'ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-ECDSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305:ECDHE-RSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305:DHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:DHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384';

# Server prefers its cipher order over the client's
ssl_prefer_server_ciphers on;

# --- Certificate paths ---
ssl_certificate     /etc/letsencrypt/live/app.example.com/fullchain.pem;
ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/app.example.com/privkey.pem;

# --- OCSP Stapling ---
# Allows the server to provide cached OCSP responses to clients
ssl_stapling on;
ssl_stapling_verify on;
ssl_trusted_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/app.example.com/chain.pem;
resolver 1.1.1.1 8.8.8.8 valid=300s;
resolver_timeout 5s;

# --- Session settings ---
# Session cache for faster resumed handshakes
ssl_session_cache shared:SSL:10m;
ssl_session_tickets off;             # Disable for forward secrecy
ssl_session_timeout 1d;

# --- DH Parameters (for DHE cipher suites) ---
ssl_dhparam /etc/nginx/dhparam.pem;

# --- HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) ---
# Tells browsers to use HTTPS only for 1 year, including subdomains
add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload" always;

# --- HTTP to HTTPS redirect ---
server {

user nginx;

    tcp_nodelay on;

    types_hash_max_size 2048;
    client_max_body_size 20M;

    include /etc/nginx/mime.types;
    default_type application/octet-stream;

    log_format main '$remote_addr - $remote_user [$time_local] "$request" '
                    '$status $body_bytes_sent "$http_referer" '
                    '"$http_user_agent" "$http_x_forwarded_for" '
                    'rt=$request_time';

    log_format rate_limited '$remote_addr - [$time_local] "$request" '
                            '$status '
                            'limit_req_status=$limit_req_status '
                            'upstream_addr=$upstream_addr '
                            'upstream_response_time=$upstream_response_time';

    access_log /var/log/nginx/access.log main;
    error_log  /var/log/nginx/error.log warn;

    # --- Upstream definition ---
    upstream app_upstream {
        # Updated by the CI/CD pipeline during blue-green deployment
        server 127.0.0.1:8080;

    gzip on;
